newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian woman swept out to sea in flash flood.
newsitem.headline: Australian woman swept out to sea in flash flood.

text.p: A 53-year-old Australian woman was swept out to sea and drowned after flash floods hit a coastal holiday town on the weekend, police said on Monday.
Alannah Amanda was torn from her husband's grasp on Saturday night as the pair attempted to leave their flooded caravan at Coffs Harbour on Australia's mid-east coast, police said.
Her body was later found 1.5 km (0.9 miles) out to sea.

Police said 300 people were evacuated from caravans and homes when floodwaters up to 1.5 metres deep (five feet) struck during a heavy storm. More than 300 homes were reported damanged, as well as 200 shops in the town's business centre.
New South Wales state premier Bob Carr on Monday declared the region a natural disaster area.
